title: Ordinary direct-image cross-restriction for subterminals
statement: Let C have a terminal object, pullbacks and binary products; let J be a topology and R a ring sheaf, with arbitrary module universe m. Let U,V be subterminal and let W,tU,tV be any pullback presentation over the terminal object. For any module sheaf M on V, the canonical restriction-adjunction map from the V-direct image to the W-direct image of M restricted to W becomes an isomorphism after restriction to U. The canonical comparison is the inverse of overFunctorMap R (W→V). No cover, sheafification or derived-category hypothesis is used.

source.place: Tag 08DG, right-direct-image and fibre calculation, extended to subterminal slices.

proof.text: Evaluate on X→U and use the unit formula for the W-adjunction. The component is the composite of two presheaf restriction maps: one from V-star of the W-counit and one from the V-unit on W×X→V.

The first underlying arrow is V×(W×X)→V×X. Construct its inverse by inserting the W-coordinate from X→U and the given V-coordinate. Check the two inverse identities using the pullback universal property and monicity of U,V→1.

Over.forget V is full by subterminality, hence its adjunction unit is invertible. Both presheaf restriction maps are therefore bijective. The presheaf and module forgetful functors reflect isomorphisms.

theorem ringedTopos_ordinaryCross_restriction
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasTerminal C] [HasPullbacks C]
    [HasBinaryProducts C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{r})
    (U V W : C) [Mono (terminal.from U)] [Mono (terminal.from V)]
    (tU : W ⟶ U) (tV : W ⟶ V)
    (hW : IsPullback tU tV (terminal.from U) (terminal.from V))
    (M : SheafOfModules.{m} (R.over V)) :
    IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{m} R U).map
      ((SheafOfModules.overPushforwardOverAdj (R := R) W).homEquiv _ _
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap R tV).inv.app
              ((SheafOfModules.pushforward (SheafOfModules.pushforwardOver (R := R) V)).obj M) ≫
          (SheafOfModules.overMap R tV).map
            ((SheafOfModules.overPushforwardOverAdj (R := R) V).counit.app M))))
